name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the context and previous conversation turns.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the degree to which the response encourages further conversation or interaction.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response within the context of the dialogue.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in introducing new ideas or facts.

name: Emotional Connection
description: Assesses how well the response resonates emotionally with the conversation partner, enhancing rapport.

name: Informational Value
description: Evaluates the usefulness of any new information presented in the response, such as facts or anecdotes relevant to the topic.
